claims.statement: URE reported 6259 renewable grid-connection refusals in 2024 totaling 42.4 GW of requested capacity.
Polish connection conditions define technical details and temporarily reserve network capacity.

contrary_evidence: Public maps and consultant judgment may satisfy many early screens.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: EPC, land-broker, and grid-consultant referrals.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 150 teams at 6000 PLN monthly yield about 10.8 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN within five to seven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly after report automation.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 80% after geodata, review, and hosting.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: under three months at two recurring teams.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1500-5000 PLN per report or 4000-12000 PLN monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: each development pipeline screens many sites and saved outcomes improve later decisions.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Each permissioned application outcome improves local labels and calibration
fingerprint.customer: Polish solar, wind, and battery developers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded referrals from land brokers and application consultants
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Probabilistic grid-readiness reports sold per site or subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The developer pays when a parcel enters screening
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A developer considers securing land before grid feasibility is known

founder_fit: Data-science skills and the family renewable installer enable a credible low-social-energy pilot.
risks: Probabilistic outputs mistaken for guarantees could create liability.
DSO process changes could invalidate features.

structure.control_point: A normalized permissioned corpus linking site features to connection decisions, constraints, and remedies
structure.critical_dependency: Lawful access to enough developer-contributed outcomes to outperform public-only screening

thesis: A site-screening engine estimates Polish renewable-project grid-connectability before land and application spend, while permissioned connection outcomes create a proprietary prediction asset.
title: GridProof Poland
uncertainties: Permissioned outcome availability and willingness to pay are unknown.
